text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Taiki...!
You've grown even stronger than last year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What a blitzkrieg...!
I was holding my breath the whole time...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you!
Was everyone excited?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not stoppin' yet!
I'll keep on runniiing just like thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeesss!
Short-distance GⅠ number two, get!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The audience's eyes were sparkling!
They were so excited by my run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so, Trainer, what is our next target race, plain and simple!?

Of course, the finale is the autumn mile championship race
that she ran in last year as well—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeeesss! It is here!
The race to crown the autumn Mile King!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I will conquer both the spring and the autumn!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I will NOT surrender the title of Mile King!!

Aiming for the glorious feat of sweeping the Spring and Autumn Mile GⅠs,
and the Autumn Short-Distance GⅠs, she takes on the Mile Championship!
